Wanderlust Android platform-only fork

Upstream: geolocator_android 4.6.2, published by Baseflow on pub.dev.
Published source: https://pub.dev/packages/geolocator_android/versions/4.6.2
Repository: https://github.com/Baseflow/flutter-geolocator
License: MIT (original LICENSE retained; Flutter includes it in app notices).

Modifications, 2026-09-30:
- Remove the proprietary play-services-location dependency and FusedLocationClient.
- Always construct LocationManagerClient; retain upstream permission handling,
  foreground service, wake lock, notification and independent subscriptions.
- Return after reporting an absent context in isLocationServiceEnabled.

Modifications, 2026-10-07:
- Renew recording location requests through restartRecordingLocation without
  cancelling the event stream or dropping foreground status and wake locks.
- Retain session options; invalidate callbacks from replaced/stopped requests.
- Promote the foreground service before starting the initial location request.
- Wire recovery through the Android method channel and clear disconnected service
  references. Add native recovery regression tests, run by the app CI job.

Runtime sources, upstream Android tests, build configuration, licence and
changelog are vendored; trailing whitespace is normalised.
No upstream binaries or Gradle wrapper are included. The app's pinned toolchain
builds this plugin. Android's platform fused provider may itself be implemented
by the device vendor; this app does not bundle or require Google Play Services.

On upstream updates: review permission and service changes, reapply the small
GeolocationManager and recording recovery changes, keep FusedLocationClient absent, and run the dependency
scan plus screen-off/location/memory regression tests on a Google-free device.

Upstream pub archive SHA-256: fcb1760a50d7500deca37c9a666785c047139b5f9ee15aa5469fae7dbbe3170d
